notes.title: Huge Update with Chillout-Mode and many more!
notes.notes:
This is a huge Update!!!
A breathtaking brand new Chillout Mode for relaxation while sitting or lying, to enjoy the music with fantastic visuals in 3D!
First time ever you can use radio stations inside of the game to power it with free music!

NEW:

   Chillout Section for relaxation while sitting or lying!
   Microphone support
   Media controller to navigate between tracks
   Several Radio Stations for unlimited music!
   8 new Environments


And as always, stay tuned for the next updates and don't forget to rate the game, it would really help!

Have a great day!!

notes.title: Radio station update on the go! Price will increase!
notes.notes:
With the next update you can choose out of some radio stations from the inside of the game without leaving and searching for your music on your desktop!
Radio-Channels are recordable so, just stream your Light And Dance VR experience and spread the visuals out to the world!

Buy a copy of Light And Dance VR now, the price will increase with the next Update!

notes.title: 2 New Environments, Performance Improvements, Bugfixes
notes.notes:
NEW:

2 new Environments
Added how to play descriptions for gamemodes


CHANGED/FIXED:

Calory calculation is more realistic now.
FREE YOURSELF: Score doesn't fly over the controller, the spheres and the rods anymore.
TINT IT: All new Environments doesn't intersect with the spheres anymore and are visible even in the craziest moments.
Textures have a better quality now.
Reflection of the Music Equalizer has been disabled to improve performance drastically.
Added some other things under the hood (two player bodies). Be keen for the next updates ;-)



And as always, stay tuned for the next updates and don't forget to rate the game, it would really help!

Have a great day!!

notes.title: Another Update: more effects, new menu/settings, controller adjustments
notes.notes:
New Menu...

Graphics-Settings:
Now it's possible to change the virtual resolution of the game.
->Set it to a higher value to get a more fancy look.

Settings for Streamers (Jeah i think about you too ːsteamhappyː):
You can now adjust the fov of the wide angle recording camera!
PS: many updates for you will follow!

Effects on the Dancefloor:
Added some particle effects when you hit the ground.
Enhanced the behaviour of the "flying sparks" flying with the trail of the controller movement

Some small adjustments on the oculus controller (hopefully for the better) ːsteamfacepalmː
